main_finding: frontmost material-ID support is an exact operational raster contract, but it is not equivalent to stable perceptual visibility, especially near silhouette boundaries and high-switch regions

cases.label: A_stable_visible
cases.interpretation: contract agrees with simulator/render-space visibility across sampled frames

cases.label: C_long_occlusion_reappearance
cases.observed_semantics: long loss of frontmost support followed by reappearance
cases.interpretation: supports coarse occlusion/reappearance semantics in simulator/render space

cases.label: D_rapid_switching
cases.observed_semantics: perceptually near-continuous surface visibility despite rapid Boolean switching

cases.label: E_moderate_switching
cases.interpretation: possible boundary/raster reassignment; three sampled frames insufficient for a strong label

cases.label: F_source_silhouette_boundary
cases.observed_semantics: source boundary point followed by sustained loss of frontmost support under deformation
cases.interpretation: consistent with coarse render-space visibility loss

cases.label: G_boundary_switching
cases.observed_semantics: perceptually continuous silhouette region with Boolean frontmost ownership changes
